deciding.result_valid: The counts reconcile (34/50 = 68%) and the cut test is done. The incubator log is missing (null), so the absence of an excursion cannot be confirmed. That is the one doubt.
deciding.next_step: incubator is null, so the log is the single missing item. Counts and cut test are otherwise in order, so the result is held pending that log.
deciding.shortfall_cause: 68% is below the 85% threshold. Of the 16 non-germinated seeds, 11 are fresh, 4 dead and 1 contaminated, so most were firm and fresh.
deciding.discrepancy_size: Recorded 70% against 68% computed from the counts. The 2-point gap is about 3% of the computed value, which is level 1. It is close to the level 0 limit.
deciding.germ_decline: The newest history entry uses AG-5, not AG-2. The matching AG-2 entry is 98.4%, a fall of about 30.4 points, right at the 30 boundary between levels 2 and 3. Comparing with the mismatched 90% entry would give 22 points, which is level 2.
